entry.title: New: Resolution 284 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE MAYOR TO ENTER INTO AN AGREEMENT WITH THE STATE OF HAWAI‘I DEPARTMENT OF HUMAN SERVICES

Allows for the receipt of $2,000,000 in federally-derived funds to support the implementation and on-going operations of a new homeless shelter program.

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 284-23 & FC-83 - 10/18/23
